newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index rises in week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index rises in week.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index rose 33.3 points or 1.18 percent last week. The All Ordinaries index rose 1.89 percent.
Sept 27 Sept 20 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.

A strong performance by middle ranking oils saw the Eyres Reed Explorer Index move 33.3 points higher but despite this, falls just outnumbered gains, Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a weekly commentary.

Discovery Petroleum NL led a re-rating of the mid-sized oil and gase stocks after Premier Oil of the U.K. bid 70 cents for the company and Oil Search Ltd announced it had acquired a 10 percent interest.
Discovery finished up 18 cents to 78 cents.

Capricorn Resources Australia NL jumped 2.5 cents to 11.5 cents after selling 50 percent of N&J Prospecting Pty Ltd, which has interests in the Higginsville region, for A$1 million and a continuing royalty.

Audax Resources NL leapt nine cents to 50 cents as the market anticipated the Bronzewing South court decision late Friday and Venture Exploration & Finance Ltd received an Australian Stock Exchange query after moving as high as 28.5 cents, finishing the week up 3.5 cents at 25 cents.

Falls included Roebuck Resources Nl, down eight cents to 33 cents, Hargraves Resources Nl, down 10 cents to A$1.04, Austpac Gold NL, down 0.8 cents to 6.6 cents. National Resources Explorations Ltd, whose shareholders approved a new issue and new name during the week, fell 0.6 cents to 7.9 cent.s
